# Descriptions
@@ 2
Allows the caster to access his memory as if he had total recall. Any skill
resolution involving Memory gets a bonus. If the skill uses Memory as one of
the stats (many Influence skills), the bonus is +10. If the skill uses Memory
as two of the stats (most Lore skills), the bonus is +25. If the skill uses
Memory as all three stats, the bonus is +50.
@@ 3
Doubles the rate at which the caster can learn a language. Every rank of
language developed (i.e., DPs spent), results in two ranks being learned.This
spell must be active for the entire time the caster is learning the language.
@@ 4
Caster learns what language a piece of text is written in, and the author (if
he was noteworthy or the caster has seen his work).
@@ 5
As Learn Language II, except rate is tripled (three ranks are gained for every
one).
@@ 6
Allows the caster to enchant general type magic items and shields giving them
a Class I magical bonus.
@@ 8
Caster can read at triple the normal rate (resulting in 3 pages per minute
while this spell is active).
@@ 9
Caster can read a piece of text and tell if it is a translation; and if so,
what the original language was and possibly the author (if he was noteworthy
or the caster has seen his work).
@@ 10
As General I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class I bonus.
@@ 11
As Learn Language II, except rate is quadrupled (i.e. 4 ranks are gained for
every one).
@@ 12
As Study III, except caster reads at five times normal rate (i.e., 5 pages per
minute).
@@ 14
As Study III, except caster reads at ten times normal rate (i.e., 10 pages per
minute).
@@ 15
As General I except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class III bonus.
@@ 20
As Study III, except caster reads as fast as he can glance at a page.
@@ 25
As Learn Language II, except rate is quintupled (i.e. 5 ranks are gained for
every one).
@@ 35
As General I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class IV bonus.
@@ 50
If the caster has access to a being that knows a certain language, he can
learn the language as well as the given being knows it. He must touch the
being and concentrate for 8 consecutive hours.
